question: Which FDIC regions improved ROA the most from 2025Q2 to 2026Q2, and did their efficiency ratios improve too?
headline: Atlanta improved ROA the most, from 0.65% in 2025Q2 to 1.29% in 2026Q2 (+0.63 points), and its efficiency ratio also improved, falling 1.74 points to 54.71%.
insights: Every FDIC region's quarterly ROA rose from 2025Q2 to 2026Q2. Behind Atlanta, Chicago gained 0.17 points, New York 0.16 and San Francisco 0.13; Dallas (+0.12) and Kansas City (+0.08) gained least.

Efficiency ratios did not move with ROA everywhere. Kansas City (-2.12 points), Atlanta (-1.74), Dallas (-1.25) and New York (-0.88) became more efficient (lower is better), but Chicago's rose 2.05 points to 57.55%, the largest deterioration, and San Francisco's rose 0.23 points.

Chicago's ROA gain came with the second-highest efficiency ratio of the six regions, so its earnings improvement was not from cost control. Efficiency ratios are year-to-date; ROA is the 2026Q2 quarter annualized.
The 'Unknown' group (banks with no institution record) is excluded from the rankings; it is in the industry totals only.

question: Which FDIC regions improved ROA the most from 2025Q2 to 2026Q2, and did their efficiency ratios improve too?
